decisions.title: Credential carrier and one consumer path
decisions.initialHypothesis: Use existing named context.credentials values; keep existing unambiguous conveniences as compatibility only. No credentials in operation input or OBI.
decisions.alternativeToCompare: Compare a typed host credential seam solely for ergonomic/secret-boundary evidence; keep one public route.
decisions.portabilityQuestion: The adopted auth families already describe named value meaning. A kind may need to identify the source scheme to which each value applies.
decisions.implementationPolicy: Alias conflict handling, redaction implementation and helper APIs are implementation choices; do not invent alternative credential spellings.
decisions.chosenExperiment: Use existing named context.credentials values; keep existing unambiguous conveniences as compatibility only. No credentials in operation input or OBI.

decisions.title: Security-alternative identity and conservative coverage
decisions.initialHypothesis: Select an exact set of source scheme names at the private security point; no choice by credential availability; all effective alternatives must fit the initial supported profile.
decisions.alternativeToCompare: Compare an authored-array index using reordered/duplicate-alternative examples. Do not expose both selectors.
decisions.portabilityQuestion: If a kind exposes selection, independent implementations need the same selected combination and anonymous behavior.
decisions.implementationPolicy: Exact representation, default-single-choice policy and refusal of a partly unsupported operation are chosen experiment/capability policies, not upstream requirements.
decisions.chosenExperiment: Select an exact set of source scheme names at the private security point; no choice by credential availability; all effective alternatives must fit the initial supported profile.

decisions.title: Per-attempt credential release scopes
decisions.initialHypothesis: Require caller-provided per-scheme origin grants in the private security configuration point; translate only selected credentials into the client, which checks actual destination.
decisions.alternativeToCompare: Compare an application-supplied typed host grant seam before freezing. Do not add both or infer permission from declarations.
decisions.portabilityQuestion: If this point is adopted, its field meaning affects observable behavior and needs definition; the decision to mandate any grant carrier is not presumed.
decisions.implementationPolicy: Acquisition, storage, broker architecture, lifetime management, normalized comparison algorithm and zeroization are not binding-spec requirements.
decisions.chosenExperiment: Require caller-provided per-scheme origin grants in the private security configuration point; translate only selected credentials into the client, which checks actual destination.

decisions.title: Challenges and terminal effects
decisions.initialHypothesis: Use named auth families and config.value for missing choice/grants; deliberate fresh attempt, no effects before challenge/refusal; retain HTTP status failures after dispatch.
decisions.alternativeToCompare: Compare an aggregate auth challenge with staged destination then auth challenges; preserve shape and avoid combinatorial work.
decisions.portabilityQuestion: Reuse adopted role effect and terminal meanings. Any new kind context point must be interpretable if later standardized.
decisions.implementationPolicy: Challenge encoding, ordering, diagnostics and storage/trust policies are not prescribed by the roles; no new generic error precedence.
decisions.chosenExperiment: Use named auth families and config.value for missing choice/grants; deliberate fresh attempt, no effects before challenge/refusal; retain HTTP status failures after dispatch.

decisions.title: Source-only synthesis with prerequisites
decisions.initialHypothesis: Represent supported secured operations without tokens; explain runtime prerequisites and keep schema-loss coverage independent. Conservatively exclude any operation with unsupported effective security alternatives.
decisions.alternativeToCompare: Compare scoped branch support only as a future alternative; do not silently narrow an operation while claiming full representation.
decisions.portabilityQuestion: Source security retains upstream meaning; the binding/context relationship may require a minimal shared meaning.
decisions.implementationPolicy: Coverage layout, naming and synthesis algorithm stay implementation choices. No auth input properties or stored credential material.
decisions.chosenExperiment: Represent supported secured operations without tokens; explain runtime prerequisites and keep schema-loss coverage independent. Conservatively exclude any operation with unsupported effective security alternatives.

decisions.title: Compatibility and ownership
decisions.initialHypothesis: Extend the two private kinds additively through one provider and unchanged roles; client pin unchanged.
decisions.alternativeToCompare: Use a fresh private label only if a selected design changes an already-supported meaning; record such a scope change explicitly.
decisions.portabilityQuestion: Future kind identifiers must have unambiguous behavior/version applicability, independent of crate/language.
decisions.implementationPolicy: Repository topology, Rust types, TypeScript wrappers and executor/cache strategy are not binding authority.
decisions.chosenExperiment: Extend the two private kinds additively through one provider and unchanged roles; client pin unchanged.

decisions.title: Finite resource and performance policy
decisions.initialHypothesis: One necessary context-byte bound plus existing traversal/result/client/terminal budgets; register differential CPU gates and owner/effect measurements.
decisions.alternativeToCompare: If reuse of a named budget does not bound actual auth work, add a narrowly owned adapter bound and prove it.
decisions.portabilityQuestion: Do not turn budgets, caches, benchmark ratios or counters into binding semantics.
decisions.implementationPolicy: Numeric limits, single-entry caching, copies, locking, benchmark hosts and instrumentation remain engineering policy.
decisions.chosenExperiment: One necessary context-byte bound plus existing traversal/result/client/terminal budgets; register differential CPU gates and owner/effect measurements.

promotionRule: Evidence may propose minimal fresh specification content only when independently implemented observable behavior would otherwise diverge. No automatic promotion of context policy or client behavior.
